qs.q: Why did the student's first survey fail?
qs.evi: the sample was too small — only twelve people
qs.why: The student explicitly blames the small sample size, not the questions.
qs.whyZh: 学生明确归因于样本太小，而非问题不清楚。

qs.q: What will the student aim for next time?
qs.evi: I'll aim for at least a hundred responses

3.tHtml:
TUTOR: So why did your first survey fail?
STUDENT: Mainly because the sample was too small — only twelve people8, so the results were not reliable. Next time I'll aim for at least a hundred responses9.

qs.q: Coral reefs support about ______ of all marine species.
qs.evi: they support around a quarter of all marine species

qs.q: The greatest threat is rising sea ______.
qs.evi: the greatest threat … is rising sea temperature
qs.why: The lecturer says temperature (which causes bleaching), not sea levels — a classic distractor.
qs.whyZh: 讲师说的是温度（导致白化），不是海平面 — 典型干扰项。

4.tHtml: LECTURER: Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they support around a quarter of all marine species10. The greatest threat to them today is rising sea temperature, which causes bleaching.
